ja201:1.1: There is no bond stronger, so say the wise,
ja201:1.2: Whether made of iron, wood, or bulrush,
ja201:1.3: An obsession for jewels and earrings,
ja201:1.4: And the longing towards both sons and wives.
ja201:2.1: This bond is the stronger, so say the wise,
ja201:2.2: Dragging down, pliant, hard to get free from,
ja201:2.3: Having cut this also, the wise depart,
